# config: ssh: implement some tips and tricks from the Carlos' guide

Add an SSH configuration to the dotfiles following Carlos Becker's [SSH tips and tricks](https://carlosbecker.com/posts/ssh-tips-and-tricks/): a managed `~/.ssh/config` with `Include`, per-host keys via `IdentityFile`/`IdentitiesOnly`, `AddKeysToAgent` + `UseKeychain` on macOS, connection multiplexing (`ControlMaster`/`ControlPersist`), and the like.
